statement:
∀ M : ℝ, 1≤M → ∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∀ (a τ : ℝ) (f w : KdVPlan.Coeff), KdVPlan.StepData gamma M a τ f w →
∀ t∈Icc a (a+τ), KdVPlan.HB 0 (KdVPlan.tri a t (fun _=>f) (fun _=>f) (fun _=>f)) (C*KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w)
proof:
intro M hM
rcases h_T006.1.2.1 0 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) with ⟨C0,hC0,htr0⟩
rcases h_T006.1.2.1 gamma h_H002.1.le h_H002.2 with ⟨Cg,hCg,htrg⟩
let C := 3*C0*(M+1)^2+Cg*(M+1)^3
refine ⟨C,by dsimp [C]; positivity,?_⟩
intro a τ f w hs t ht
have hsmall := (yui_aux_0005 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2.2 M a τ f w hs
rcases hs with ⟨_,ha,hτ,hτ1,hf,hw,hsf,hsw,hwM,hd1⟩
have hw0 := h_T013.2.2.2.1 0 gamma w h_H002.1.le hw.1
have hwbound : KdVPlan.hn 0 w≤M+1 := by linarith [hw0.2]
have hfn := (yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2.2
have hnF := hfn 0 f
have hnW := hfn 0 w
have hnD := hfn 0 (f-w)
have hnG := hfn gamma w
have hdmem := (yui_aux_0005 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1 0 f w hf.1 hw0.1
have hzd : KdVPlan.ZeroMean (f-w) := by change f 0-w 0=0; rw [hf.2.1,hw.2.1]; ring
have htlen : t-a≤1 := by linarith [ht.2]
have h1 := htr0 a t ha ht.1 htlen (f-w) f f hdmem.1 hf.1 hf.1 hzd hf.2.1 hf.2.1
have h2 := htr0 a t ha ht.1 htlen w (f-w) f hw0.1 hdmem.1 hf.1 hw.2.1 hzd hf.2.1
have h3 := htr0 a t ha ht.1 htlen w w (f-w) hw0.1 hw0.1 hdmem.1 hw.2.1 hw.2.1 hzd
have h4 := htrg a t ha ht.1 htlen w w w hw.1 hw.1 hw.1 hw.2.1 hw.2.1 hw.2.1
simp only [Real.rpow_zero,mul_one] at h1 h2 h3
have hsum := (yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1
have hs12 := hsum 0 _ _ h1.1 h2.1
have hs123 := hsum 0 _ _ hs12.1 h3.1
have hsall := hsum 0 _ _ hs123.1 h4.1
rw [yui_aux_0067 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 a t f w ht.1 hsf hsw hf.2.1 hw.2.1]
refine ⟨hsall.1,?_⟩
have hp : (t-a)^gamma ≤ τ^gamma := Real.rpow_le_rpow (by linarith [ht.1]) (by linarith [ht.2]) h_H002.1.le
have hu1 : C0*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w)*KdVPlan.hn 0 f*KdVPlan.hn 0 f ≤ C0*(M+1)^2*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w) := by
  calc
    _ ≤ C0*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w)*(M+1)*(M+1) := by gcongr; exact hsmall.1; exact hsmall.1
    _ = _ := by ring
have hu2 : C0*KdVPlan.hn 0 w*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w)*KdVPlan.hn 0 f ≤ C0*(M+1)^2*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w) := by
  calc
    _ ≤ C0*(M+1)*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w)*(M+1) := by gcongr; exact hwbound; exact hsmall.1
    _ = _ := by ring
have hu3 : C0*KdVPlan.hn 0 w*KdVPlan.hn 0 w*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w) ≤ C0*(M+1)^2*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w) := by
  calc
    _ ≤ C0*(M+1)*(M+1)*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w) := by gcongr; exact hwbound; exact hwbound
    _ = _ := by ring
have hu4 : Cg*(t-a)^gamma*KdVPlan.hn gamma w*KdVPlan.hn gamma w*KdVPlan.hn gamma w ≤ Cg*(M+1)^3*τ^gamma := by
  calc
    _ ≤ Cg*τ^gamma*(M+1)*(M+1)*(M+1) := by gcongr <;> linarith
    _ = _ := by ring
have hδq : KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-w)≤KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w := le_add_of_nonneg_left (Real.rpow_nonneg hτ.le gamma)
have hpq : τ^gamma≤KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w := le_add_of_nonneg_right (hfn 0 (f-w))
dsimp [C]
have hA : 0≤3*C0*(M+1)^2 := by positivity
have hB : 0≤Cg*(M+1)^3 := by positivity
nlinarith [h1.2,h2.2,h3.2,h4.2,hs12.2,hs123.2,hsall.2,
 mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδq hA,mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpq hB]
